attention.title: {count} disk needs attention: its backups are stopped
attention.help: A backup left the machine in a state that may lose data (for example it still writes in an overlay file). Nothing was deleted and nothing is repaired by itself. Check the disks of the machine on the hypervisor, then resume its backups.
attention.resumeTitle: Resume the backups of this machine?
attention.resumeBody: Confirm that the disk {disk} of {name} was checked on the hypervisor: the machine writes in its normal disk file and no overlay file is left. Its backups will start again at the next run.
attention.resumed: The backups of {name} will start again.
attention.resumeFailed: The backups could not be resumed.

notRunningTitle: Machines that are not running are not backed up, and are not counted as protected or at risk. Click to show them
